parts.script: A: Hey, did you try that new café that just opened on Elm Street?  B: No, not yet! I heard they have amazing pastries.  A: Yes, they do! I had a chocolate croissant there yesterday, and it was one of the best I've ever had.  B: That sounds delicious! What else did you try?  A: I also had their espresso, which was really strong but very smooth.  B: Nice! I usually prefer tea; do they have a good selection of that?  A: They do! They have a variety of herbal and black teas. I think you’d like their chamomile.  B: Great! Is the place crowded?  A: It was a bit busy when I went, but I found a nice corner table. They also have outdoor seating, which is lovely if the weather is nice.  B: I’ll definitely check it out this weekend. Thanks for the recommendation!  A: No problem! Let me know what you think once you try it.
